CodeGen_Generator.evidence: Backend pass driver; contains both post-schedule and post-coloring trace strings and iterates pcbasicblocks. Canonical name follows the existing MWCC debugger/decomp nomenclature.

colorgraph.evidence: Takes an interference-graph node list, assigns physical colors from an availability mask, and returns failure when a node must spill. Signature and behavior match colorgraph in Coloring.c.

register_allocation_driver.evidence: Iterates seven register classes, constructs a coloring work list, invokes colorgraph, and retries after spill processing.

schedule_current_function.evidence: Called by CodeGen_Generator immediately before the post-schedule trace point.

pcbasicblocks.evidence: CodeGen_Generator walks this linked list and each block's instruction list before object generation.

interferencegraph.evidence: Base pointer used by colorgraph to resolve interference nodes by virtual-register index.

coloring_class.evidence: Register-class selector set by the allocation driver and consumed by colorgraph.

function_record.evidence: IrOptimizer_driver at 0x004d13c6 stores its first argument in gFunction. The following diagnostic and optimizer helpers read *(gFunction+0x08)+0x0a as the C string name; live GDB decoded load_indexed from the smoke fixture.

name_table_entry.evidence: FUN_004e4140 walks the pointer at 0x00636424 through entry+0 and reads entry+4 as a shared frontend name record before applying record+0x08/+0x0a. Live smoke capture traversed the local names base and index.

ast_traversal.evidence: FUN_004dc900 sets DAT_0061b9f0 to its function argument before calling FUN_004e3df0 and clears it after FUN_004dcd60; AST traversal helpers compare the root against the sentinel at 0x0061b9f4.

iro_node.evidence: FUN_00579d90 allocates and zeroes 0x44 bytes. FUN_00564c70 and FUN_0058c840 traverse node+0x40; the latter reads node+0x2c as the operation descriptor. Operand-root is the pointer at node+0x10 observed in the live record.

operation_record.evidence: IRO consumers dispatch on the byte at the descriptor addressed by node+0x2c. No semantics are assigned here to descriptor bytes beyond the proven leading opcode.

driver.evidence: The string IrOptimizer.c at 0x005e91b0 is referenced by this driver; it sets gFunction, builds the flow graph, and runs the frontend pass loop.

build_flow_graph.evidence: The driver pushes the IRO root at 0x00635a5c then calls FUN_0058c840; the call returns at 0x004d1512 before the IRO_BuildflowGraph diagnostic.

optimization_boundaries.evidence: Each pass call is directly visible in the IrOptimizer_driver decompile and immediately followed by its embedded IRO_* diagnostic string. RepositionCode is gated after a flow-graph rebuild near the driver tail.

live_capture.evidence: A GDB batch run of the exact b210 compiler with the fixture stopped after gFunction assignment and after BuildflowGraph. It decoded load_indexed through record+0x08/+0x0a and an IRO node with a descriptor whose first byte is 0x3a (decimal 58); heap addresses were intentionally omitted because they are process-specific.

frontend_ir.evidence: All addresses are image-base virtual addresses for the profile binary. The pure model validates this exact layout before reading live memory and terminates bounded linked-list walks on null, limit, unreadable memory, or cycle.

scheduler.evidence: FUN_004c0790 invokes the per-block scheduler at 0x004c07e0. That routine allocates 0x1c-byte SchedulerNode records and 0x0c-byte source-to-target edges. FUN_004c0a00 selects a node only when pending_predecessors is zero, earliest_issue_cycle is no later than the current cycle, and callback_table[+0x10] accepts its PCode. Its ladder prefers a crossed critical deadline, then more targets waiting on their final predecessor, then longer critical path, then lower heuristic latency when pressure_mode is set; its optional pressure probe is FUN_004c14b0. Globals and offsets were confirmed in the exact b210 decompilation.

register_allocation.evidence: At 0x004c1d74 colorgraph has returned for the current class while the contiguous 0x20-byte IGNode array, 0x10-byte incidence records, and uint16 coalesce-parent map remain live. Physical nodes are [0,P); virtual nodes are [P,N).

pcode_opcode_table.evidence: PCodeInfo.c initializer 0x0047ccc0 clears 0x4af entries at 0x00626638 with stride 0x30; independent readers at 0x004925c0, 0x0049bd50, and 0x004c2f30 use the same table. Opcode 1 registration at 0x0047ccc0 supplies the sentinel values.
